Remark
[Derivatives and scaling] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0260, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0261 1. ch14:14.8\group Scaling

Under $g\mapsto cg$, distances scale by $c^{1/2}$, while \[ |\operatorname {Rm}|\sim c^{-1},\qquad | abla ^m\operatorname {Rm}|\sim c^{-(m+2)/2}. \] Under parabolic rescaling $\widetilde g(\widetilde t)=cg(t)$, $\widetilde t=ct$, the quantity $t^{m/2}| abla ^m\operatorname {Rm}|$ scales in the same way as $|\operatorname {Rm}|$. Hence the estimate in Theorem 2 is scale-covariant.
